extractions.value: Patient had intestinal follicular lymphoma diagnosed at age 69. Initial presentation at age 72 with difficulty walking, dysphagia and vocal cord paralysis was attributed to Lrp4 antibody-associated disorder and treated with steroids; Lrp4 antibodies later became negative. PERM with GlyR antibodies was diagnosed at age 74.
